notes.title: Version 0.1.1 Patch
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes 3.21.25
Version: 0.1.1

Fixed Issues:
- HQ Progression: Cobb now says her unique into dialogue every time, the Mission Pad is no longer inaccessible due to the soft lock.
- Giza Lab: All waves spwan every time, Player is no longer soft locked.
- Reptoids and High Value Targets: Now have updated grenade effects.
- Loot Drop Rates: Adjusted with more opportunity for mods, even on Commons.
- New informative load screen tool tips!
- Side mission end of mission clean up, pardon the dust.

On Radar:
- Missions ending and no opportunity to pick up loot, we're reevaluating how end of mission functions.
- Some collision issues and areas Players are not supposed to go resulting in death.
- Some UI navigation issues and confusing wording.
- Boss fights with far too aggressive behaviors.

If you have reported a bug, issue, or suggestion it's in our log. Have a great weekend!
